rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a sweater that is pulled on over the head rather than fastened at the front.

example.english: This pullover is very warm, so it is perfect for winter.
example.traditional: 呢件套頭毛衣好暖，冬天着佢就啱晒。
example.jyutping: ni1 gin6 tou3 tau4 mou4 ji1 hou2 nyun5 dung1 tin1 zoek3 keoi5 zau6 ngaam1 saai3

rows.note: Use this broader term when the garment is a pullover top but its being a woollen sweater is not being emphasized.

example.english: I usually wear a pullover because it is convenient and comfortable.
example.traditional: 我平時都着套頭衫，方便又舒服。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ping4 si4 dou1 zoek3 tou3 tau4 saam1 fong1 bin6 jau6 syu1 fuk6
